sections.title: 1. NATURE OF REGISTRATION AND NO OBLIGATION
sections.body: Registration in the waitlist (the "Waitlist") for the EQUITTY project (the "Platform") creates only an expectation of rights for the user. Joining the Waitlist does not guarantee account opening, immediate access to services, or a binding contractual offer from the Platform. EQUITTY is an initiative in launch phase; therefore, access will be granted gradually, at the Platform's discretion, and subject to technical availability.

sections.title: 2. CONSENT FOR COMMUNICATIONS
sections.body: By registering, the user grants express, prior, and informed consent to receive electronic communications regarding waitlist status, launch timeline updates, and EQUITTY corporate news. The user may withdraw this consent at any time using the unsubscribe (opt-out) mechanism included in each email.

sections.title: 3. PRIVACY AND DATA PROTECTION
sections.body: EQUITTY is committed to processing the user's personal data under strict confidentiality standards, in accordance with the principles of personal data protection regulations of the Republic of El Salvador. Collected data will be used exclusively to manage platform access and validate user identity. No data transfers to third parties will be made without prior consent, except when legally required by a competent authority.

sections.title: 4. DISCLAIMER OF ADVICE AND RISKS
sections.body: The information provided at this expectation stage is strictly informational and does not constitute financial, legal, tax advice, or an investment recommendation. The user acknowledges that investments carry inherent risks and understands that, before receiving any final product or service, the user must successfully complete legal verification, compliance (KYC/AML), and execution of definitive agreements.

sections.title: 5. INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY
sections.body: All intellectual property rights over content, trademarks, logos, and concepts presented at this stage are the exclusive property of EQUITTY. Joining the Waitlist does not grant any license of use or rights over such assets.

sections.title: 6. MODIFICATION AND TERMINATION
sections.body: EQUITTY reserves the right to modify, suspend, or terminate the Waitlist phase at any time and without prior notice, for technical, commercial, or legal reasons, without generating any right to compensation in favor of registered users.

sections.title: 7. JURISDICTION AND DISPUTE RESOLUTION
sections.body: Any dispute arising from interpretation or compliance with these Terms shall be resolved through Equity Arbitration, in accordance with the Rules of the Mediation and Arbitration Center of the Chamber of Commerce and Industry of El Salvador.

item1.question: Can I invest today?
item1.answer: Not yet. Equitty is not offering investments or raising capital. Opportunities will open for qualified investors when the framework allows it.

item2.question: What is Equitty building?
item2.answer: A marketplace for tokenized real-world assets in El Salvador: inventory, metrics, and a regulated flow. The product is under construction, and we are not showing platform screenshots at this stage.

item3.question: Who will be able to invest at launch?
item3.answer: Authorized and qualified investors under the CNAD framework. Broader retail access is planned for a later phase.

item4.question: What regulation does this sit under?
item4.answer: The platform is designed for El Salvador and the CNAD framework. The DASP license is in process; issuances will be private and for qualified investors.

Platform.heroSubtitle: A credible preview of how EQUITTY will connect capital to real-world assets within a regulated framework.
Platform.problemTitle: Capital exists. Assets exist. Access does not.
Platform.problemBody: Today, there is no regulated infrastructure connecting global and diaspora capital to Latin American real estate, infrastructure, and private assets. Traditional channels require minimums of $250,000 or more. There is no retail access point. There is no institutional gateway. There is no secondary market.
Platform.problemBodyTwo: EQUITTY is designed to solve this within a compliant, regulated framework.
Platform.discoverText: Browse curated, vetted real-world assets—real estate, infrastructure, and private credit opportunities across Latin America, each with transparent financial information and regulatory documentation.
Platform.investText: Participate through a compliant onboarding process. The platform is being designed to allow participation from $100 (when licensed), with full institutional-grade structuring available at scale.
Platform.earnText: Receive distributions and track real-time performance through the investor dashboard—built for transparency and ongoing reporting.
Platform.exitText: Access secondary market liquidity through the platform's trading infrastructure—planned for Phase 4, subject to regulatory milestones.
Platform.disclaimer: All platform features described are in development and subject to regulatory approval, licensing, and phased launch readiness.
Platform.listingCta: Interested in listing your project? Contact us

Regulatory.heroTitle: Compliance is not a checkbox. It is the foundation.
Regulatory.heroSubtitle: Designed from day one inside El Salvador's digital-asset framework: file first, build the infrastructure, and launch only when ready.

license.title: License first
license.text: We will apply in 2026 for the DASP license under El Salvador's Digital Assets Law. We will not operate in a gray area; we will operate on the law.

structure.title: Dual jurisdiction
structure.text: EQUITTY Holdings Inc. (Delaware) owns EQUITTY S.A.S. de C.V. (El Salvador): U.S. governance with operations under El Salvador's digital-asset framework.

protection.title: Investor protection
protection.text: Dedicated Delaware SPVs, milestone-based capital release, KYC/AML before funds move, and CNAD filings for each private offering.

transparency.title: Public status
transparency.text: Regulatory status stays public. If the DASP license is granted or a phase milestone lands, we will say so.

Regulatory.launchLead: Access opens in phases. Nothing is for sale today.

timing.label: When
timing.text: First offering targeted for Q3 2026, subject to DASP approval.

who.label: Who
who.text: Authorized and qualified investors under the CNAD framework.

next.label: Later
next.text: General retail access is planned for a later phase.

Regulatory.launchNote: We are not accepting investor applications, expressions of interest, or capital commitments at this time.
